there is no convincing evidence that IGF‐I is a risk factor for breast cancer in postmenopausal women.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IGF‐1 system is not associated with postmenopausal cancer.

The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no evidence that circulating levels of insulin‐growth factor‐1, its binding proteins or C‐peptide are associated with risk of postmenpauzal breast cancer.
circulating levels of IGP‐I and its binding proteins are not associated with the development of breast cancer in postmenopausal women.
